areas.name: Health (SUS)
areas.reason: Objectives focus on access to public health, but the contingent credit funds no specific investment; benefit is indirect via making the PPP more attractive; qualified indicators.

areas.name: Women
areas.reason: Only a specific objective touches women's care; no dedicated resources, but the PPP indirectly enables a maternal-child unit with delivery-related facilities.

areas.name: Anti-racism
areas.reason: Contractual commitment to raise representation of racial and ethnic groups in hospital management gives indirect, localised potential; no specific resources.

areas.name: Fiscal sustainability
areas.reason: Core area: general objective and the single component are the guarantee of the state's PPP obligations; SMART indicator; large fiscal benefits and high replicability; highly efficient.

areas.name: Human rights
areas.reason: Credit does not directly finance human-rights actions and the inclusion target is not relevant enough for the objective; classified N/A.

areas.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation
areas.reason: Sustainable processes and waste treatment are outside prevention, risk management or climate adaptation; below minimum criteria, N/A.

areas.name: Clean energy
areas.reason: Renewable generation is indirect and limited to the hospital; the sole indicator is an infrastructure certification and not satisfactory; not relevant nationally; N/A.

bonus.reason: Proponent declared resources exclusively for federal priorities; accepted under the new growth-acceleration programme, health axis, as funds are tied to a qualified maternity proposal being reallocated to the PPP.
Proponent did not state the project promotes regional integration; no points.
